specTitle: Test Case 1: Navigate to UD Loans Payment Guide page via Loan Payment Guides dropdown
title: AC1: Navigate to Loan Payment Guides Page and select UD Loans
preconditions: User is on the UnionDigital Bank homepage (https://uniondigitalbank.io/en)
steps:
1. Navigate to https://uniondigitalbank.io/en
2. Click on 'Loan Payment Guides' nav item
3. Click on 'UD Loans' link in the dropdown
expected: UD Loans Payment Guide page is displayed at https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans

specTitle: Test Case 1: Verify '+' expand icon is visible on UD Loans Payment Guide accordion
title: ED-74 AC1: Validate Expand Option - '+' icon visible on 'How To Pay Your UD Loans'
preconditions: User navigates directly to the UD Loans Payment Guide page (https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans)
steps:
1. Navigate to https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans
2. Verify the page heading 'UD LOANS PAYMENT GUIDES' is visible
3. Locate the accordion item 'How To Pay Your UD Loans'
4. Verify the accordion button is in collapsed state (aria-expanded='false')
5. Verify the '+' icon is displayed to the right of 'How To Pay Your UD Loans' text
expected: The accordion item 'How To Pay Your UD Loans' is visible and its expand button has aria-expanded='false', confirming the '+' icon is rendered on the right side of the text

specTitle: Test Case 1: Verify 'Click here to pay via UPAY' link is visible under the UPAY payment section
title: ED-76 AC1: Validate UPAY Link - 'Click here to pay via UPAY' link is visible under UPAY section
preconditions: User is on the UD Loans Payment Guide page (https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans) with payment option details displayed (accordion expanded)
steps:
1. Navigate to https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans
2. Click the 'How To Pay Your UD Loans' accordion button to expand payment options
3. Scroll to the 'Pay through your other bank accounts or e-wallets via UPAY.' section
4. Observe the 'Click here to pay via UPAY' link below the UPAY section heading
expected: 'Click here to pay via UPAY' link is displayed and visible under the 'Pay through your other bank accounts or e-wallets via UPAY.' section

specTitle: Test Case 1: Verify Free UnionBank payment options section is visible
title: ED-77 AC1: Verify 'Free UnionBank payment options' section is displayed on Loan Payment page
preconditions: User is on the UD Loans Payment Guide page (https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans) with the 'How To Pay Your UD Loans' accordion expanded
steps:
1. Navigate to https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans
2. Click the 'How To Pay Your UD Loans' accordion button to expand payment options
3. Observe the '1. Free UnionBank payment options' section heading in the accordion panel
expected: '1. Free UnionBank payment options' section text is visible in the expanded accordion panel

specTitle: Test Case 2: Verify UPAY payment section is visible on Loan Payment page
title: ED-77 AC2: Verify 'Pay through your other bank accounts or e-wallets via UPAY' section is displayed on Loan Payment page
preconditions: User is on the UD Loans Payment Guide page (https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans) with the 'How To Pay Your UD Loans' accordion expanded
steps:
1. Navigate to https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans

expected: '2. Pay through your other bank accounts or e-wallets via UPAY.' section text is visible in the expanded accordion panel

specTitle: Test Case 1: Click PAY VIA UPAY NOW and verify UD Loans payment page is displayed
title: ED-78 AC1: Initiate UPAY Payment - clicking PAY VIA UPAY NOW displays UD Loans by UnionDigital Bank Payment Page
preconditions: User is on the Loan Payment page (https://loans.uniondigitalbank.io/LoanPayment)
steps:
1. Navigate to https://loans.uniondigitalbank.io/LoanPayment
2. Locate the 'PAY VIA UPAY NOW' button under the 'Pay through your other bank accounts or e-wallets via UPAY.' section
3. Click the 'PAY VIA UPAY NOW' button
4. Observe the resulting page
expected: The URL changes to https://loans.uniondigitalbank.io/LoanPayment/UPay and the heading 'UD Loans by UnionDigital Bank Payment Page' is displayed on the page

specTitle: Test Case 1: Verify Loan Number and Payment Amount text boxes are displayed on UD Loans Payment Page

specTitle: Test Case 2: Verify UD Loans by UnionDigital Bank Payment Page heading text is displayed

specTitle: Test Case 1: Agent Builder page loads successfully
title: AVVA-SMOKE AC1: Verify Agent Builder page loads with canvas and key elements visible
preconditions: User is authenticated via Microsoft SSO (storageState configured). AVVA Console is accessible at https://int-ai.aava.ai/
steps:
1. Navigate to https://int-ai.aava.ai/launchpad/build/agent
2. Wait for page to fully load (networkidle state)
3. Verify agent canvas element is visible
4. Verify page title contains 'Agent Builder'
5. Verify page URL matches expected pattern
expected: Agent Builder page loads successfully. Canvas is visible and interactive. Page title is 'AVVA - Agent Builder'. URL is https://int-ai.aava.ai/launchpad/build/agent

specTitle: Test Case 2: User creates agent with minimal configuration
title: AVVA-SMOKE AC2: Verify user can create agent with name and single tool selection
preconditions: User is on Agent Builder page (https://int-ai.aava.ai/launchpad/build/agent)
steps:
1. Enter unique agent name in agent name input field
2. Select 'browser' tool from tool palette
3. Click 'Save Agent' button
4. Wait for save operation to complete
5. Observe success notification
expected: Agent is saved successfully. Success toast notification displays 'Agent saved successfully'. User is redirected to agent detail page with URL pattern /agents/{id}

specTitle: Test Case 3: Validation error shown for empty agent name
title: AVVA-SMOKE AC3: Verify validation error displays when agent name is empty
preconditions: User is on Agent Builder page with a new agent form
steps:
1. Leave agent name field empty (clear any existing text)
2. Click 'Save Agent' button
3. Observe validation error message
expected: Validation error message displays 'Name is required'. Form does not submit. Agent is not saved. User remains on Agent Builder page

specTitle: Test Case 4: User selects multiple tools successfully
title: AVVA-SMOKE AC4: Verify user can select multiple tools from tool palette
preconditions: User is on Agent Builder page with a new agent form
steps:
1. Enter unique agent name
2. Select 'browser' tool checkbox
3. Select 'vscode-runCommand' tool checkbox
4. Select 'edit-createFile' tool checkbox
5. Verify all three tools show as selected (checked state)
expected: All three tools ('browser', 'vscode-runCommand', 'edit-createFile') are successfully selected and display checked state. Tool palette allows multiple selections

specTitle: Test Case 5: User selects model from dropdown
title: AVVA-SMOKE AC5: Verify user can configure agent model from dropdown
preconditions: User is on Agent Builder page with a new agent form
steps:
1. Enter unique agent name
2. Open model selection dropdown
3. Select 'Claude Sonnet 4.6' model
4. Select at least one tool ('browser')
5. Click 'Save Agent' button
6. Observe success notification
expected: Model 'Claude Sonnet 4.6' is selected successfully. Agent saves with selected model configuration. Success toast notification displays 'Agent saved successfully'

specTitle: Test Case 6: Agent canvas is visible and interactive
title: AVVA-SMOKE AC6: Verify agent canvas is visible and accepts interactions
preconditions: User is on Agent Builder page (https://int-ai.aava.ai/launchpad/build/agent)
steps:
1. Navigate to Agent Builder page
2. Wait for canvas element to load
3. Verify canvas is visible and not obscured
4. Verify canvas accepts focus/interaction
5. Verify tool palette is adjacent to canvas
expected: Agent canvas is fully visible and interactive. Canvas element is in a ready state. Tool palette is visible and positioned correctly. Canvas displays placeholder or initial state appropriately

specTitle: Test Case 7: Save button functionality
title: AVVA-SMOKE AC7: Verify Save Agent button triggers save operation
preconditions: User is on Agent Builder page with agent configuration filled
steps:
1. Enter unique agent name
2. Select 'browser' tool
3. Click 'Save Agent' button
4. Observe loading indicator appears
5. Wait for save operation to complete
6. Observe page transition or notification
expected: Save Agent button is clickable and enabled. Clicking triggers save operation. Loading spinner appears briefly. Save completes successfully. Success notification or redirect occurs

specTitle: Test Case 8: Toast notification on successful save
title: AVVA-SMOKE AC8: Verify success toast notification displays after agent save
preconditions: User has filled agent form with valid configuration
steps:
1. Enter unique agent name
2. Select 'browser' tool
3. Click 'Save Agent' button
4. Wait for save operation to complete
5. Observe toast notification area
expected: Success toast notification appears with message 'Agent saved successfully'. Toast is visible for 3-5 seconds. Toast auto-dismisses or has close button. Toast styling indicates success (green color/checkmark icon)
